statCard.name: Black Widow, Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D.
statCard.artist: Patrick Brown, Gary Daniels III and Alex Trip

attacks.name: Automatic Pistol
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

|*Rapid Fire|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Automatic Pistol| attack. This additional attack must target the original defender. The additional attack does not have the |*Rapid Fire| special rule.

attacks.name: Tear Gas
steps: The defender does not gain |!power| for |!damage| dealt by this attack.
After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§poison§Poison| special condition.

attacks.name: Widow‘s Kiss
steps: Add 1 die to this attack roll for each special condition the defender has.
|!wild| |*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Push the defender Away |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Interrogate
superPowers.body: At the start of the Cleanup Phase, if this character is within |!range| 2 of one or more Dazed enemy characters, it may use this superpower. Its controlling player increases the amount of VPs they score from Crisis cards during this Cleanup Phase by 1.

superPowers.name: Parting Shot
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, this character may use this superpower. The attacking character suffers 1 |!damage|. This character may Advance Away from the attacking character |!range_small|.
